_about: The Workshop window (workshop.html): every technology Machina Christi uses or plans to use. One pane each, in tiers from the visitor's hands down to the workbench. status is 'live' or 'planned' (planned panes name their roadmap phase). touches lists the panes it connects to; the page lights them together. To add a technology, add a pane here; nothing else changes.

tiers.name: The watch
tiers.note: keeping an eye on it all

tiers.name: The workbench
tiers.note: how it is made and kept

panes.name: three.js
panes.what: A 3D graphics library for the web.
panes.here: Draws Eden, its garden, creatures and light, right in your browser.

panes.name: Canvas
panes.what: The browser's 2D drawing surface.
panes.here: Camino is drawn frame by frame on a canvas: the road, the pilgrim, the wayside crosses.

panes.name: Web Audio
panes.what: The browser's sound engine.
panes.here: Camino's chant and Eden's ambience are composed live in code. There are no recordings.

panes.name: Speech synthesis
panes.what: The voices built into your device.
panes.here: Reads the prayers on Pray aloud, in Thai and in English.

panes.name: Cloudflare
panes.what: A global network that stands in front of the site.
panes.here: Encrypts every connection, caches what it can, counts visits without cookies, and turns away floods: more than 20 requests to the API in 10 seconds is refused.

panes.name: Security headers
panes.what: Rules sent with every page that tell your browser what is allowed.
panes.here: No framing by other sites, no plugins, no hidden permissions. A stricter content policy is being tried in report-only mode first.

panes.name: Static Web Apps
panes.what: Azure's host for websites.
panes.here: Serves every page of Machina Christi on the free plan, and builds a preview copy of the site for each proposed change.

panes.name: Functions
panes.what: Code that runs only when it is called.
panes.here: The API at api.machinachristi.com. Today it reports its own health; next it computes the Church's calendar. It sleeps when no one calls, and only Cloudflare may reach it.

panes.name: Managed identity
panes.what: An identity Azure gives a service, so it can prove who it is without a password.
panes.here: How the API reaches its storage and its telemetry. There are no keys or connection strings anywhere to leak.

panes.name: Entra ID
panes.what: Microsoft's sign-in and access service.
panes.here: Will guard a small admin page for editing the saints and keeping the prayer wall.

panes.name: Blob Storage
panes.what: Azure's file storage.
panes.here: Holds the API's code and working state. Its keys are switched off: only the API's own identity can enter.

panes.name: Azure SQL
panes.what: A relational database.
panes.here: Will hold the saints of Ordo: feasts, centuries, patronages. Visitors never wait on it; a daily job publishes what the site needs.

panes.name: Cosmos DB
panes.what: A database of documents.
panes.here: Will hold the prayers of Pray, each in Thai, English and transliteration.

panes.name: AI Search
panes.what: Search as a service.
panes.here: Will let you search across saints and prayers at once.

panes.name: AI Speech
panes.what: Speech made and heard by machine.
panes.here: Will give each prayer a natural Thai recording, and later help learners practise saying it.

panes.name: Content Safety
panes.what: A service that screens text for harm.
panes.here: Will read prayer intentions before they appear on the prayer wall.

panes.name: SignalR
panes.what: Live messages between visitors.
panes.here: Will let you see other visitors' candles as fireflies in Eden.

panes.name: Application Insights
panes.what: Azure's monitoring for apps and pages.
panes.here: Counts page views, time on page and errors, with no cookies and nothing that follows you, and watches every API request.

panes.name: Log Analytics
panes.what: Where telemetry is kept and questioned, in a language called KQL.
panes.here: Two stores, each with a hard daily limit, so the site stays inside its free allowance.

panes.name: Budget
panes.what: A spending alarm.
panes.here: Rings at the first dollar. Everything here is built to run on free allowances, so any spending at all is a signal.

panes.name: GitHub
panes.what: Where the code lives.
panes.here: All of Machina Christi is public. Every change arrives as a pull request.

panes.name: GitHub Actions
panes.what: Automation that runs on every change.
panes.here: Tests each change, previews its effect on Azure, and on merge deploys the site and the API, signing in to Azure without any stored password.

panes.name: Bicep
panes.what: Azure's language for writing infrastructure down as code.
panes.here: Every Azure part of this site is described in Bicep. Rebuilding it all is one command.

panes.name: Playwright
panes.what: A robot that uses web pages the way you do.
panes.here: Before anything merges, about a hundred tests walk every page: Eden must grow, Camino must play, no security rule may break.

panes.name: Azure DevOps
panes.what: Boards for planning work.
panes.here: Every release, from Eden's weekly growth to this roadmap's eight phases, is planned there.

panes.name: Claude
panes.what: An AI assistant made by Anthropic.
panes.here: Writes much of the code beside the builder, one conversation at a time, and each week tends Eden with a new detail drawn from Scripture.
